info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: pAne pibati, rakzAyAM pAti, pAyati SozaRe ' (Slo. 5) iti devaH .

examples: 'yenA niraMhaso yUyaM pATa neTA ca martyamati dvizaH' (f0 10.126.2). nizpATa=sarvato rakzaTa.
'ftaM piparttyanftaM ni pAti' (aTarva0 9.10.23). kadA ca na prayucCasyuBe nipAsi janmanI (lO0 gf0 8.7 ityatra devapAlena BAzye samudDfto mantraH). nipAsi nitarAM rakzasi.
'ftasya padaM kavayo ni pAnti' (f0 10.5.2). ukto'rTaH.
'sA no amAso araRe ni pAtu' (f0 10.63.16).
'tfzRArtESca nipIyate vanamfgEruzRaM payaH sArasam' (mfcCa0 8.11). nipIyate nirDIyate.
'(tAM) nipIyamAnalAvaRyAM lolErdevAsurekzaREH' (kaTA0 50.132). ukto'rTaH.
'dantacCadaM priyatamena nipItasAram' (ftu0 4.13). nipItaScUzitaH sAro'sya taM taTABUtam.
'nipAnaM sarvaBUtAnAM BUtvA tvaM pAvanaM mahat' (BA0 SAM0 18.17). nipAnamAhAvaH.
'gAhantAM mahizA nipAnasalilaM SfNgErmuhustAqitam' (SA0 2.6). nipAnaM palvalam.

'SAstraprataptA nipibanti cAnye' (vAmanapu0 10.43). nipibanti nitarAM pibanti. nipatantIti pAWAntaram.
'nipAne mahizaM rAtrO' (rA0 2.63.21). nIcEravatIrya pIyate'treti nadyavatArasTalam, tIrTamiti yAvat.
'agnizwvABi pAtu' (vA0 saM0 13.19). aBitaH pAtvityarTaH.
'yo vAmadabDo aBi pAti cittiBiH' (f0 8.59.3). avekzate, pratijAgartItyarTaH.
'sA mA satyoktiH pari pAtu viSvataH' (f0 10.37.2). paripAtu trAyatAm. pariSabdArTo viSvata ityanenEvokta iti parirnAtIvopakaroti DAtvarTam.
'nadasya nAde pari pAtu me manaH' (f0 10.11.2).
'uBe rodasI pari pAsato naH' (f0 7.34.23). pAsata iti lewi praTamapuruzadvivacane rUpam.
'sa no'yaM darBaH pari pAtu viSvataH' (aTarva0 19.32.10). AsUdAhftizu pariSabdo nArTAntaramAha.
'paripARaM puruzARAm' (aTarva0 4.9.2). paripARaM parirakzaRasADanam.
'paTaspaTaH paripatiM vacasyA' (f0 6.49.8). paripatimaDipatim.
